subject: RE: [EXTERNAL] Re: Encord <> AbbVie - Weekly
text:
Hello,

I know we went over this item in our last engagement however, wanted to understand timeline for the fix as it is causing some disruption.

Title: UI Regression: Loss of bulk-hide functionality for "Approved" labels
Description: A recent UI/UX design change removed the ability to hide all "Approved" labels with a single click, severely slowing down the annotation review workflow.
Previous Behavior: Approved labels automatically moved to a dedicated "Completed reviews" section in the sidebar. This section had its own parent "hide/eye" icon, allowing users to hide all approved labels at once. This made it very easy to declutter the canvas and concentrate exclusively on "Pending" labels.
Current (Buggy) Behavior: The "Completed reviews" section no longer exists. When a user tries to isolate and view only the Pending labels:

  1.  Clicking the main "hide eye" icon at the top hides all labels across all statuses (e.g., hiding all 25 labels instead of just the 9 Approved ones).
  2.  To hide only the Approved labels, users are now forced to click the individual "eye" icon for each approved label one at a time.
Impact: Users can no longer quickly filter their visual workspace. Isolating Pending labels now requires tedious, repetitive clicking, reducing productivity.

subject: RE: Encord - business case + catch-up in September
text:
Hi James,

Sorry for the late reply – last week was pretty packed due to PI planning, so your mail got stuck in my to-do list.

Thanks for sharing the info with us! Let me answer the questions below:

  1.  Let’s go with 10 (heavy) users for an indication.
I assume that we have much more users that occasionally would tune in and scroll through and filter the available data to add sequences to datasets. Would that make any difference in payment and how would that differ to “heavy users”? Are licenses linked to a specific user (e.g. email) or is it a max. amount of active users on the platform?
  2.  Please give us an indication for 10.000h and 100.000h. Are there any scaling effects?
  3.  Rather our own embeddings, but please also give an indication what it would cost to use your embedding method for filtering.
  4.  We would rather go with our own VPC or on-prem solution to avoid egress costs, fast access and keep data governance simple

BR Florian
